newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Dec oil exports to slip - deputy minister.
newsitem.headline: Russian Dec oil exports to slip - deputy minister.

text.p: Russian crude oil exports in December will fall by an unspecified amount because of a government programme to put more oil in domestic refineries, Deputy Fuel and Energy Minister Valery Garipov said on Tuesday.
He declined to say by what percent exports would be reduced.
A ministry official who declined to be identified said export licences were being issued for 10 days at a time, three times a month.
Only producers which had sent enough crude to domestic refineries would be allowed to export the rest.
"Companies had just started exporting everything they had and nothing remained here," said the unnamed official.
"If a company doesn't fulfil its 10-day task, then it doesn't get permission to export over the next 10 days."
Russia normally publishes a monthly export schedule.
Both officials said the measures were in force only for December and declined to say whether they would be extended.
